sql: select not exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(:channels::jsonb, '[]')) c, brandbase.brands b where b.id = :brand and (not c = any (b.linked) or not c = any (brandbase.allowed_channels(coalesce(:format::text, (select p.format from brandbase.posts p where p.id = :id)))))) as ok
message: an account is not linked to this brand, or the format cannot go there
